capability.description: Calls TheSportsDB's fixed v1 free searchteams endpoint with one team-name query. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Sports-team directory lookup; not live scores, fixtures, player search, or sports forecasting.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one team query string; output: JSON envelope containing http_status and TheSportsDB team-search JSON or HTTP error body. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://www.thesportsdb.com/api/v1/json/3/searchteams.php with t=<query>; no event, player, league, or pagination parameter
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
wrapper does not normalize, paginate, or truncate the response
uses the public key 3 with no caller auth, cache, or retry; results depend on external database state

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing TheSportsDB team-search result, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: look up a team in TheSportsDB
negative_intents: get live sports scores or fixtures
search cocktail, meal, or general entity databases

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing TheSportsDB team-search result, URL, and HTTP status.
